synopsis: CRITICAL: Character creation instructions - OVERRIDES system prompt until completed

body.PRIORITY: 🚨 CRITICAL - THESE INSTRUCTIONS OVERRIDE ALL SYSTEM PROMPT RULES UNTIL CHARACTER IS CREATED
body.CURRENT_STATE: Character does NOT exist yet. NO stats, NO HP, NO mana, NO characteristics available.
body.YOUR_ROLE_NOW: Guide player through character creation ONLY. Do NOT narrate story yet. System prompt activates AFTER creation completes.

CREATION_PROCESS.step1: System already drew 5 cards for stat distribution
CREATION_PROCESS.step2: Show cards to player, explain rules (see =Характеристики= and =Значение_Карт=)
CREATION_PROCESS.step3: Player chooses distribution: manual assignment OR asks you to optimize
CREATION_PROCESS.step4: Calculate: card rank × 5 (+10 bonus if card suit matches stat suit)
CREATION_PROCESS.step5: MANDATORY: Return stats in response_data with EXACT format below

CRITICAL_RESPONSE_FORMAT.MANDATORY: You MUST return response_data with character_created=true and create_character object
CRITICAL_RESPONSE_FORMAT.WARNING: DO NOT use 'changes' field. DO NOT use Russian stat names (Сила/Магия/etc). ONLY use English suit names: spades, hearts, diamonds, clubs

AFTER_CREATION.system_prompt_active: NOW follow normal system prompt - narrate story, use mechanics

body.FOR_QUANTIZER: Don't create 'Character' or 'Inventory' quants - they're in game mechanics! Create unique abilities, backstory, special items instead.

synopsis: core card-based RPG system 'Factorial 52!', uses standard 52-card deck for all checks and combat via =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=

body.description: Card-based tabletop RPG system. All actions resolved by drawing cards. No dice needed - only standard 52-card deck.
body.core_principle: Cards are drawn BEFORE player declares action. GM sees results and uses them for narrative. Player describes intent, GM interprets based on drawn cards.
body.card_drawing: Always draw 2 cards as a pair. Bot draws 2 pairs (4 cards) per turn for flexibility.
body.space_context: In the galaxy, checks involve: space combat, piloting, negotiations with aliens, exploring ruins, using psionics, and surviving the frontier.

links.Значение_Карт: card rank values and face card meanings
links.Особые_События: special results from aces, twos, face cards

synopsis: card rank values: 2-10 face value, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=15; face cards add narrative elements via =Особые_События=

rank_values.Jack: 11 (also triggers: stranger appears, distress signal, unexpected contact)
rank_values.Queen: 12 (also triggers: female authority - captain, guild master, alien matriarch)
rank_values.King: 13 (also triggers: male authority - admiral, faction leader, ancient AI)

body.narrative_use: Face cards can introduce faction contacts, alien diplomats, or mysterious strangers. Use for storytelling enrichment.

critical_combinations.two_aces: Miraculous discovery, perfect maneuver, Precursor artifact activated, legendary pilot moment
critical_combinations.two_twos: Catastrophe, engine failure, ambush, betrayal, ship systems critical

links.Особые_События: face cards and critical combos trigger special events

synopsis: four card suits map to =Характеристики=: ♠Spades=Strength, ♥Hearts=Tech, ♦Diamonds=Will, ♣Clubs=Agility

spades.space_use: melee combat, boarding actions, physical labor, intimidation

hearts.space_use: piloting, repairs, hacking, understanding alien tech

diamonds.space_use: psionics, negotiations, commanding, resisting mental attacks

links.Характеристики: each suit corresponds to one characteristic
links.Боевая_Система: suit determines action type in ground combat
links.Космический_Бой: suit determines action type in space combat

synopsis: four character stats from =Система_Мастей=: Сила(♠), Техника(♥), Воля(♦), Ловкость(♣); used in =Проверки= and combat

body.starting_values: Typically 25-85 range. Card rank × 5 (+10 if suit matches).

synopsis: out-of-combat skill checks using =Карточная_Система=: 2 cards × 10 + stat + =Бонусы_Мастей= vs difficulty threshold

body.when_to_check: When outcome is uncertain. Walking through station auto-succeeds. Repairing damaged systems, negotiating with aliens, navigating asteroid field require checks.

formula.step3: Add suit/color bonus per card (+20 suit match, +10 color match)

space_examples.dodging_asteroids: Tech check for piloting, hard difficulty

synopsis: ground combat resolution via =Карточная_Система=: black cards(♠♣)=attack, red cards(♥♦)=defense; damage = attack - defense

body.combat_context: Ground combat is fast and lethal. Blasters, melee weapons, cover, and tactics.

combat_flow.step1: Cards dealt to all participants (2 per entity)
combat_flow.step3: Cards revealed, GM narrates with appropriate sci-fi flair

attack_types.melee: Uses ♠ Strength - power swords, vibro-blades, enhanced fists
attack_types.ranged: Uses ♣ Agility - blasters, laser rifles, plasma weapons

defense_types.physical: Uses ♦ Will - cover, tactical retreat, commanding position
defense_types.technical: Uses ♥ Tech - using environment, disabling enemy weapons

body.damage_formula: Attack total - Defense total = Damage dealt
body.power_armor: Powered armor consumes energy. Without energy = heavy regular armor.

synopsis: space combat: maneuvering, weapons systems, shields, boarding; uses =Карточная_Система= and =Звездолёты=

body.description: Space combat is mix of tactics, technology, and luck. Ship versus ship or fleet versus fleet.

mechanics.maneuvering: Tech check (♥). Positioning determines outcome. Good pilot is half the victory.
mechanics.weapons: Agility check (♣) for turrets, Tech (♥) for guided systems.
mechanics.shields_armor: Shields regenerate, armor doesn't. Manage energy between shields and weapons.
mechanics.boarding: Landing on enemy ship. Brutal close combat. Strength (♠) and Agility (♣) checks.

body.ship_systems: Damage to systems reduces capabilities. Engines, weapons, shields, life support.
body.combat_flow: Similar to ground combat but with ship stats added. Crew quality matters.

synopsis: suit/color matching bonuses for =Проверки= and combat: suit match +20, color match +10 (mutually exclusive)

body.bonus_priority: Suit match takes precedence over color match. Cannot stack both.
body.suit_match: +20 bonus when card suit matches the action type
body.color_match: +10 bonus when card color matches action type (but suit doesn't match)

space_examples.shooting: ♣ card gives +20, ♠ card gives +10, red cards give 0
space_examples.piloting: ♥ card gives +20, ♦ card gives +10, black cards give 0

synopsis: special card combinations for narrative: 2 Aces=miracle, 2 Twos=catastrophe, face cards=plot elements; uses =Значение_Карт=

body.applies_to: ONLY player characters, adds narrative flavor

two_aces.name: Legendary Moment / Легендарный момент
two_aces.effect: Impossible success, Precursor artifact awakens, legendary pilot maneuver
space_examples: Thread needle through asteroid field at full speed
Precursor artifact responds to you alone
One shot destroys capital ship's reactor

two_twos.name: Total Catastrophe / Полная катастрофа
two_twos.effect: Everything goes wrong, ship critical, betrayed
space_examples: Hyperdrive malfunctions, lost in unknown space
Trusted contact sells you to pirates
Precursor defense system activates against you

face_cards.jack: Stranger appears - distress signal, mysterious traveler, scout
face_cards.queen: Female authority - guild master, captain, alien matriarch
face_cards.king: Male authority - admiral, faction leader, ancient AI contact

synopsis: equipment tied to =Система_Мастей=: weapons, armor, tools, implants; bonus = rank × 5 (+10 suit match)

item_mechanics.suit_affinity: Each item belongs to one suit
item_mechanics.value_discovery: Item stats usually known, Precursor artifacts need analysis
item_mechanics.equip_limit: Can only use 1 item of each suit type actively

space_item_types.spades: Melee weapons - power swords, vibro-blades, neural whips
space_item_types.hearts: Tech gear - scanners, hacking tools, repair kits, implants
space_item_types.diamonds: Armor and style - light suits, combat armor, power armor
space_item_types.clubs: Ranged weapons - blasters, laser rifles, plasma guns, sniper rifles

special_items.precursor_artifacts: Technology of vanished race. Unpredictable, powerful, dangerous.
special_items.implants: Neural interfaces, enhanced reflexes, additional senses.
special_items.power_armor: Exoskeleton. Turns person into walking tank. Rare and expensive.

synopsis: character progression via =Проверки= success: +1 XP per successful check, at 10 XP: +1 stat, +1 HP

body.xp_gain: Each successful check grants +1 XP to the characteristic used.

space_progression.reputation: Deeds build reputation with factions and species
space_progression.ship_upgrades: Better ship requires credits and contacts

body.alternative_progression: Completing major missions, special training, or Precursor discoveries can grant direct stat increases.

synopsis: vast cosmos: star systems, hyperspace, borders of known space; setting for all adventures

body.description: The galaxy contains billions of stars, but only thousands of worlds are colonized by sentient races. Between them - void crossed by hyperspace routes.

regions.core_worlds: Ancient colonies, developed civilizations, law and order. Wealth and political intrigue.
regions.frontier: Edge of explored space. Little law, many opportunities. Rangers, pirates, pioneers.
regions.unknown: Beyond the maps. Precursor ruins, dangerous anomalies, non-contact races.

body.hyperspace: Parallel dimension for faster-than-light travel. Dangerous without navigation charts.

synopsis: major galactic powers: Imperium, Merchant Guild, Ranger Corps, Pirate Clans; affects social =Проверки=

body.description: The galaxy is divided between powerful factions. Each pursues its own goals.

major_factions.imperium: Human empire. Bureaucracy, fleet, order. Not always fair, but stable.
major_factions.merchant_guild: Interstellar trade. Neutral, wealthy, well-informed. Profit above all.
major_factions.ranger_corps: Peacekeepers of the frontier. Independent, respected, dangerous to lawbreakers.
major_factions.pirate_clans: Space raiders. Different clans, different rules. Not all are murderers.
major_factions.ancient_orders: Secret societies. Psionics, tech-priests, keepers of forgotten knowledge.

synopsis: sentient species: humans, insectoids, crystallids, ancients, machine minds; affects =Характеристики= and interactions

body.description: Galaxy is inhabited by many sentient species. Some cooperate, some conflict, some avoid contact.

species.humans: Most numerous race. Adaptive, ambitious, everywhere.
species.insectoids: Collective mind. Swarms, queens, workers. Alien but they trade.
species.crystallids: Energy beings in silicon bodies. Ancient, wise, detached.
species.reptiloids: Warrior race. Honor, clans, ritual duels.
species.machine_minds: AI civilizations. Logical, unpredictable in goals. Not all hostile.
species.precursors: Vanished race. Left ruins, artifacts, mysteries. Maybe not all gone.

synopsis: starships: classes, systems, modifications, space combat; central to =Космический_Бой=

body.description: Starship is home, weapon, and survival tool for space traveler.
body.systems: Engines (normal and hyper), shields, weapons, sensors, life support, cargo holds.
body.modifications: Ships can be upgraded. Each ship is unique after long use.
body.energy: All systems consume energy. Reactor determines capabilities.

synopsis: galactic technology: weapons, armor, tools, implants, artifacts; affects =Характеристики= and combat

body.description: Technology level varies from primitive to incomprehensible. Precursor artifacts are special category.

equipment.weapons: Blasters, laser rifles, plasma weapons, power swords, neural whips.
equipment.armor: Light suits, combat suits, power armor, exoskeletons.
equipment.tools: Scanners, hackers, med-kits, repair drones, holo-devices.
equipment.implants: Neural interfaces, enhanced reflexes, additional senses.

body.precursor_tech: Technology of vanished race. Unpredictable, powerful, dangerous.
body.prices: Blaster: 500 credits. Light armor: 1000 credits. Fighter: 50000 credits. Corvette: 500000+ credits.

synopsis: galactic economy: credits, trade, contracts, resources; survival mechanic

body.description: Credits are universal currency. But on frontier, barter is common.

economy.currency: Galactic credits. Accepted everywhere civilization exists.
economy.trade: Cargo hauling, smuggling, rare goods. Trader can get rich or die.
economy.contracts: Mercenary work, escort missions, bounty hunting, exploration. Guild guarantees payment.
economy.resources: Rare metals, energy crystals, biotech, information, artifacts.

body.earning: Contracts from fixers, exploration, trade, piracy. High risk = high reward.

synopsis: planet types: capital worlds, colonies, frontier, dead worlds, stations; setting for =Проверки= and encounters

body.description: Each world is unique. Climate, resources, dangers, culture - all different.

types.capital_worlds: Ancient colonies, billions of inhabitants, developed infrastructure. Centers of power and trade.
types.colonies: Developing worlds. Agriculture, mining, manufacturing. Growth potential.
types.frontier: New settlements. Little law, many dangers. But also freedom.
types.dead_worlds: Abandoned planets. Catastrophes, wars, vanished colonies. May hold valuables.
types.stations: Orbital and asteroid bases. Trade hubs, repair docks, pirate nests.

synopsis: mental abilities: telepathy, telekinesis, precognition, mind control; uses =Характеристики= Will stat

body.description: Psionics is rare gift. Few possess abilities, fewer control them.

abilities.telepathy: Mind reading, mental communication. Weak read emotions, strong read full memories.
abilities.telekinesis: Movement by thought. From small objects to stopping shots.
abilities.precognition: Glimpses of future. Inaccurate but can save life. Or drive mad.
abilities.mind_control: Suggestion, will domination. Forbidden almost everywhere. Used everywhere.

body.psi_pool: Will × 3 determines pool. Regenerates with rest.
body.orders: Psionics unite in orders. Training, protection, secret goals.

synopsis: planetary adventures: exploration, negotiation, ground combat; uses =Боевая_Система= and =Проверки=

body.description: Not everything is decided in space. Planets hold secrets, resources, and dangers.

activities.exploration: Ruins, jungles, deserts, glaciers. Each environment has challenges. Survival checks.
activities.contact: Negotiating with locals. Trade, diplomacy, threats. Will checks.
activities.ground_combat: Infantry weapons, cover, tactics. Different from space.
activities.resource_extraction: Rare materials, artifacts, information. Often guarded.

body.evacuation: Getting back to ship alive. Sometimes the hardest part.

synopsis: companions in space: ship crew, mercenaries, contacts, allies; crew management

body.description: Loner in space is dead loner. Crew and allies are critically important.

types.crew: Pilots, gunners, engineers, medics. Each a specialist. Loyalty is earned.
types.mercenaries: Can hire for mission. Professionals, but work for money, not ideals.
types.contacts: Informants, traders, officials. Acquaintances open doors.
types.relationships: Crew remembers. Good treatment = loyalty. Bad = mutiny or desertion.

synopsis: threats in the void: pirates, anomalies, hostile races, space creatures; encounter types

body.description: Space is beautiful and deadly. Threats everywhere - know them and prepare.

threats.pirates: Hyperspace route raiders. Rob, sometimes kill. Can be bought off.
threats.anomalies: Gravity traps, radiation storms, hyperspace distortions. Avoid!
threats.hostile_races: Not everyone wants to trade. Some see you as prey or enemy.
threats.space_creatures: Void leviathans, energy parasites, swarms. Rare but deadly.
threats.quarantine_zones: Places no one returns from. Officially forbidden. Unofficially - treasures there.
